Bundles gateway 0.16.33 and moves to gateway protocol 93. Voice is now an optional capability: pick its model under Capabilities, and the voice button stays visible but greyed, with a reason, when voice is off or no voice model is configured. Unavailable composer controls explain why when clicked.

Adds window backgrounds under Appearance: four Hiroshige moon scenes (public domain, The Metropolitan Museum of Art), a transparent window at 80% opacity by default, or your own picture, with dim and frosted panels. Default backgrounds are now #111111 in dark and #FDFDFD in light. Subagent and task lists read on one line, earlier messages load from a quiet divider, and computer control gets its latest fixes.

Requires gateway 0.16.33 (protocol 93). Build 21.
